description: Suggest a meal for the person to approve in the Metrics Nest app. This only leaves a suggestion: nothing is logged until they approve it and then log it from their phone, where they can change it on the plate first; no log entry is ever created, changed or deleted here. Give each food a name and, where you can, its grams and its calories and macros for that portion; leave out any figure you do not know rather than guessing. Make up a new idempotency_key for each suggestion and send the same one only when retrying this exact call. Works only where the person allowed this connection to suggest (get_profile says can_propose). list_meal_proposals shows what became of each suggestion.

client.description: For a coach: a client id from list_clients, to read that client. Omitted: your own account.

idempotency_key.description: Unique per suggestion; the same key again returns the first suggestion instead of a duplicate.

name.description: The food, as it would be logged: "Basmati rice, cooked".

planned_for.description: The day it is meant for, in the account time zone: today up to 28 days ahead.

rationale.description: Why this meal, in a few sentences the person reads before approving.

slot.description: Which meal of the day it is for.

title.description: What the meal is, as the person will see it: "Chicken rice bowl".

name: propose_meal
title: Suggest a meal
